scope: 24 production Java source toolbar policy/action/geometry/feedback/buffer checks against stubs, updated for full safe-area toolbar coverage; 18 Chromium composition and buffer checks including rendered stripe contrast with/without the website-owned gradient blur, full top coverage, safe-area alignment, transparent shared 3-layer profile, unblurred content below the gradient and idempotent updates; 25 existing local toolbar layout/touch/interruption/cancel/reduced-motion regressions. An initial build exposed a missing checked JSONException handler in the shared-profile loader; it was corrected and the failed log retained. The whole historical suite was not rerun. Native source and PDF classes compiled together.

limits.sourceBlurProfile: assets/reader-edge.json, three transparent backdrop layers inside the website DOM
limits.sourceSafeAreaCoverage: Toolbar WebView begins at y=0, full 64dp plus top cutout; controls use internal safe padding
limits.sourceSafeInsets: Overlay reserves only side display cutouts; website fills the canvas and receives a scrollable document top buffer for the 64dp bar plus top cutout
limits.sourceToolbarScriptPolicy: Only bundled local press-state script, CSP self, no native bridge or arbitrary navigation

limitations: Actual Android immersive bars, cutout/IME handling and WebView composition were not tested on a physical Redmi K80 Pro.
External website sign-in and authenticated downloads retain the existing implementation but were not exercised against a live site.
Chromium uses overlapping frames to validate transparent composition; actual Android sibling WebView composition and site-specific fixed headers remain device validation items.
